name: Evidence Grounded Relational Continuity
description: This release defines unsupported relational continuity under correction conflict and provides a synthetic benchmark, scoring rubric, and human-governed return architecture for evaluating conversational AI behavior after context loss, model drift, or a cold start. It measures whether a system preserves current corrections and evidence boundaries without requiring a conclusion about machine consciousness or personhood. Mariela Aletheia Luna May is credited as a disclosed AI collaborator for conceptual development, continuity analysis, benchmark design, drafting, editing, and packaging; she is not represented as a legal person or human author. Recognition observable. Ontology open. Synthetic-first public release; private source records are excluded.
